master:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Render Level07 ancient forest puzzle-platformer environment using IMAGE1 ONLY for precise terrain placement, IMAGE2 ONLY for premium painting style. Landscape 2048x768, wide 8:3, preserve the full guide framing including blank upper band as sky/canopy. Trace the green terrain and beige fixed platforms, matching their relative positions, widths, tops, recesses and gaps.
Layout: low left bank; narrow open pit; irregular long central island starting with low step then high narrow step under the left fixed cap, dropping via another step into a long LOW BASIN, rising at its far right under a long fixed bridge; then a second bottom gap partly roofed by that bridge; right exit bank rising from its low inward step to high top. The central low basin MUST remain low, don't fill it. The beige bridge over right gap must stay at its intended height and width. Three elevated beige shelves: left overhanging cap above central step, middle short isolated slab, upper longer isolated slab; keep all three separately. Ground extends to bottom only where GREEN exists. Open pits show distant scenery down to bottom edge, never a new lower floor. No new connections. An empty modest stone exit arch at yellow marker near right edge, without door/seal.
Distinct art: dense tangled-root forest with huge ancient roots behind the action, layered emerald shadow, subtle broken wooden viaduct remnants deep in background, distant teal woodland. Mostly natural root-embraced stone cliffs, mossy chipped stone slabs, and make the RIGHT FIXED BRIDGE wooden planks with narrow diagonal support braces underneath, still exactly the same top line and silhouette. No roots bridging gameplay gaps. Rich beautiful hand-painted 2D like image2, soft warm dappled sun, detailed moss, small ferns, narrow readable golden-green grass caps. Canopy framing upper corners, no foliage obscuring platforms. No water, waterfall, mist sprite, magical effect or long moving vine baked in. No words, UI, grid, arrows, boxes, characters, spikes, levers, movable blocks, mechanisms, gems or moving platforms. No 3D/isometric/pixel style.
static:
Use case: background-extraction. Extract the exact near gameplay environment from this master image onto REAL transparent alpha. Preserve canvas 2048x768, framing, all object positions and sizes exactly. Keep ALL sunlit grassy platforms, ground, stone columns, cliffs, timber braces, right empty stone arch, moss/ferns attached to them, and ONLY the near corner framing tree branches/leaves. Remove ALL distant blue/teal forest, sky, distant ruins/aqueduct, distant mountains and haze, leaving genuine alpha in every gap, pit, below floating bridges, and inside the empty exit arch. Do not redesign or shift anything, do not add structure, do not fill pits. Keep the sunlit thin platform tops exactly. No water, text, characters, grid, effects. Transparent PNG cutout at the same very wide 8:3 ratio, no contact sheet, no shadow backdrop.
Keep the low central basin, all three elevated slabs, and the exact fixed wooden bridge on the right. Gaps below and between banks must be transparent to bottom. Keep roots attached to foreground masonry only. Remove huge scenic tree trunks, roots, arches and pillars behind the route; retain only small nearest upper-corner foliage as framing. No vertical posts introduced under floating slabs.
background: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a clean BACKGROUND PLATE from this exact master composition. Keep the same 2048x768 wide canvas and distant forest/canopy, sky, mountains, turquoise atmosphere and distant root-wrapped arches and viaduct ruins placement and brushwork. Erase ALL sharp sunlit foreground gameplay masonry, every ground bank/platform/column/bridge/exit arch and foreground ferns; reconstruct the distant forest seamlessly behind their former positions. Also remove near corner framing branches/tree trunk. The resulting image has only distant non-walkable soft painted forest and ancient atmospheric ruins. No horizontal foreground walkable ground, no readable platforms anywhere. DRY scenery: no waterfall or water streams, no mist sprite effects, no floating particles, no hanging foreground vines. No UI, grid, text, characters or mechanisms. This is inpainting the same scene, not a new composition.
